# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon is a lenient teacher who maintains poor overall discipline in his classroom, often ignoring smaller children and permitting lax behavior. However, he can also display severe, sarcastic, and spiteful discipline, regularly striking students and publicly humiliating them over their schoolwork. He pays special attention to older pupils preparing for examinations—particularly Sukey Pullen—and occasionally shows a sentimental or poetic side.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the teacher at Brierley school. During his tenure, he spent much of his effort giving individual instruction to older pupils preparing for the Regent's examination—most notably Sukey Pullen, whom he courted both in class and by visiting her home almost every night under the guise of assisting her schoolwork. He maintained loose overall discipline, allowing students to play and talk during lessons, though he occasionally struck children or punished pupils severely, such as making Nell Harcourt stand on the dais after an outburst and publicly mocking her spelling and geometry skills. Despite criticisms of his teaching abilities, he praised Nell to Obed as the school's brightest student. During a school Mayflower outing, he gathered blossoms to present to Sukey Pullen. At the end of his term, he delivered an emotional farewell speech to the school, leaving both himself and the weeping students deeply moved before departing his position.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_
